validation.device_gate: Runs llama-server --list-devices inside the isolated namespace before loading the model; requires CUDA0 and forbids CUDA1 in output. A gate failure returns before server/model startup.

launch_policy: Fresh outer preflight; then inside-namespace backend/device gate; only if both pass, load the pinned GGUF and execute the same single Codex tool-loop request. All prior memory, PSI, temperature, network, timeout, and cleanup guards remain active.
